core_obligations: Preserve read-once depth2 AC0[xor] basis AND/OR/XOR with free input negations, explicit PRG quantifiers and O(logn+log(1/epsilon)(loglog(1/epsilon))^5) seed/error conditions.
Retain full subset-wise symmetric-polynomial construction and deterministic/probabilistic tail proof rather than just citing the new core.
Retain all Section4 restriction constants/distributions and complete heavy,sparse,well-behaved bucket arguments with probability,moment,Fourier-norm and tail continuations.

Retain full Section5 recursive restriction/long-formula/base PRG construction,seed and error induction,arbitrary-width/error and final gate-model reduction. Support/parameter variants count together once.
Retain printed source constants/conventions and disclosed parameter疑点 without guessing replacements or repairing author mathematics.
difficulty_reason: The non-routine construction combines subset-wise symmetric tail control with three complementary restriction analyses, then uses a recursive proper-formula scheme whose seed costs form a geometric series and whose error remains near-optimal.

dedup.scope: Root searched complete manifest/prepared/both active lines for exact CCC2020.6 DOI and ECCC TR19-149 with zero matches. Hoza's same-title DHH2 page confirms CCC2020/ECCC; nearby ToC2022 is a different paper, not an alias. Main PRG, subset-wise tail support, restriction cases and error/width/gate extensions grouped once. GA080 concerns Gaussian PTF PRGs, GA089 weighted PRG error reduction: different test models and constructions.
